run_each_with: python3 -B -P scripts/eng4_gpu_line.py run <line>  (precheck + lease + receipts; see the script docstring)
scope: the lead runs each line in a systemd scope with MemoryMax=12G and OOMPolicy=continue; no line sets RLIMIT_AS / ulimit -v / prlimit
order_of_runs: any; g4_<arm>_NN lines of one arm run in number order (each continues the series); a g4 line whose series is complete exits 0 at once. If g4_<arm>_10 ends with the series incomplete, rerun the same command (it continues).
after_lines_cpu: python3 -B -P scripts/eng4_g3.py compare artifacts/eng4/gpu/g3_B/g3 artifacts/eng4/gpu/g3_E/g3 artifacts/eng4/G3_COMPARE.json
python3 -B -P scripts/eng4_mutant_results.py gpu  (adds m02's GPU result to MUTANT_RESULTS.json)

lines.description: G2 Build B: sanitizer preflight + ENG-MM1 under memcheck (expect OOB read)
lines.forge_command: forge-gpu-run --min 240 --max 540 --label eng4-g2_B -- timeout 480s python3 -B -P scripts/eng4_gpu_line.py step g2_B

lines.description: G2 Build E: sanitizer preflight + ENG-MM1 under memcheck (expect refusal, 0 errors)
